findings.title: `get_item_key` applies `math.floor`/`math.ceil` to a datetime attribute
findings.description: The new `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key` does `int(math.floor(value) ...)` / `math.ceil(value)` on `getattr(item, self.key)`. The endpoint calls this paginator with `order_by="-datetime"`, so `value` is a `datetime`, which `math.floor` and `math.ceil` reject with a `TypeError`. Any non-empty page taken through the `optimized_pagination=true` path should fail when the cursor is built. `DateTimePaginator` exists for this reason and converts the value first. The new class does not.

findings.title: Negative-offset branch slices the queryset with a negative start index
findings.description: When `enable_advanced_features` is set and `cursor.offset < 0`, the code runs `queryset[start_offset:stop]` with `start_offset = cursor.offset`. Django querysets do not support negative indexing and raise an assertion or value error. The inline comment says "The underlying Django ORM properly handles negative slicing automatically," which is incorrect. This branch cannot return results and will fail for any admin who sends a negative offset.

findings.title: Comment says negative offsets are allowed, but the code clamps them to zero
findings.description: The added comment says the change allows negative offsets. The code, `start_offset = max(0, offset) if not cursor.is_prev else offset`, clamps negative offsets to 0 for non-prev cursors. The behavior and the comment disagree, and the comment should describe what the code does.

findings.title: Admin-only pagination mode relies on an unverified queryset guarantee
findings.description: A client query parameter (`optimized_pagination=true`) switches to a paginator that accepts negative offsets for superusers or global-access members. The code comment says "permissions are checked at the queryset level," but nothing in the diff shows that. The pagination path should be checked for how far an offset can reach past the intended page boundaries.

findings.title: `enable_advanced_features` kwarg may not be forwarded by `self.paginate`
findings.description: The endpoint passes `enable_advanced_features=True` to `self.paginate(...)`. Whether `paginate` forwards extra keyword arguments to `paginator_cls` cannot be confirmed from the diff. If it does not, every call on this branch raises a `TypeError`.

findings.title: `Span` gains a required positional field placed before a defaulted field
findings.description: `end_timestamp_precise: float` is inserted before `is_segment_span: bool = False`. Any code that builds `Span` positionally, rather than by keyword, will now bind arguments to the wrong fields. The diff does not show the other call sites, so this is unverified.

findings.title: `now` used in `test_backpressure` without a visible definition
findings.description: The new `end_timestamp_precise=now` arguments depend on a `now` name that is not shown in the hunk. If it is not defined in that function's scope, the test fails with a `NameError`. Confirming this needs the full file.
